currency_assumptions: Budget/scoring currency is USD; venue-local costs are recorded in KRW (cost_local_amount/cost_local_currency KRW).

USD equivalent at the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate dated 2026-11-20 (EUR 1 = USD 1.0990; EUR 1 = KRW 1472.04), fetched 2026-11-20 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (Cube time='2026-11-20'); derived 1 KRW = USD 0.000746583 (1.0990 / 1472.04), i.e. 1 USD = 1339.44 KRW. Every converted KRW amount in venues.raw.json records this dated basis; where no dated conversion basis applies the USD equivalent stays null with a question. No FX rate is invented.
KRW amounts quoted from official rate tables that state '부가가치세 별도' (VAT excluded) are converted as published; VAT and any 부대비용 remain open verification questions, not assumptions.

open_questions: Event window assessed as 09:00-17:00 (8 hours) per the locked plan; venue windows that only start at 10:00 (Nodeul Island) or gate on a Saturday closing time carry a specific question.
